title: MOVEMENT (The Third Discipline)
style:
world electronic fusion, rhythmic driving male vocal NZ/AU accent, percussion from multiple traditions layered, tai chi flowing sections contrast with capoeira sharp accents, energising without aggression, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 96 BPM
```
lyrics:
``
[VERSE 1]
Tai Chi at sunrise — the body leads
Capoeira circle — plant your seeds
Muay Thai respect — bow before you fight
Yoga breath and pose — find the light

Haka full body — shake the ground
Capoeira ginga — always around
Aikido redirect — don't absorb the blow
Walking while you think — let the mind flow

[CHORUS]
Movement is the discipline
The body unlocks the mind
Move before you think
Leave the stuck behind
Tai Chi breath and slow
Capoeira fast and free
Movement is the layer
Between what blocks and what can be

[OUTRO]
Move.
Before anything else.
The body knows the way.
```
